remarks: Newly gut renovated from top to bottom, this stunning property lives like a single family residence, with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms spanning two stories. A partially finished LL brings the sq ft to approx 2,275. A spacious yard provides privacy while the location offers convenience to schools, transportation, shopping, the beach, town pool and more. Among the home's many perks are a gorgeous new kitchen, new bathrooms, refinished floors, new windows, new Central AC, and other new mechanicals. Laundry in unit on second level and parking for 4-5 cars. Available 6/15. Floor plans available.
